title: EMF of a rotating coil
caption: A coil of 200 turns (A = 0.05 m²) spinning at 50 rev s⁻¹ in 0.1 T has ω = 2π × 50 = 314 rad s⁻¹ and ε = NBAω sin ωt, a sine wave of peak 314 V = 200 × 0.1 × 0.05 × 314. The period is 20 ms. The EMF is largest when the coil's plane is parallel to B, where the flux is changing fastest, and zero when the flux is largest.
alt: Graph of EMF against time: a sine wave of peak 314 V and period 20 ms, shown for two cycles.
description: The horizontal axis is time in milliseconds; the vertical axis is the induced EMF in volts.
ω = 2π × 50 = 314 rad s⁻¹, so the period is 20 ms.
The peak EMF is NBAω = 200 × 0.1 × 0.05 × 314 = 314 V, reached a quarter of a period (5 ms) after the coil is perpendicular to B.
